MATCH (m:Model {model_code: 'AE5-140WAL72-0654'})

WHERE so.order_date >= date('2023-01-01') AND so.order_date <= date('2023-12-31')
MATCH (so)-[hl:HAS_LINE]->(:Listing)-[:OF_SKU]->(sku:SKU)
WITH m, hl, sku
OPTIONAL MATCH (sku)-[mp:MAPS_TO]->(m)
WITH m, hl, sku, mp
OPTIONAL MATCH (sku)-[b:BUNDLES]->(item:SKU)-[imp:MAPS_TO]->(m)

     CASE WHEN mp IS NOT NULL THEN hl.qty * mp.qty ELSE 0 END AS direct_qty,
     CASE WHEN b IS NOT NULL AND imp IS NOT NULL THEN hl.qty * b.qty * imp.qty ELSE 0 END AS bundle_qty
RETURN sum(direct_qty + bundle_qty) AS total_units
```
